newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian civil servants demonstrate over cuts.
newsitem.headline: Austrian civil servants demonstrate over cuts.

text.p: Up to 3,000 Austrian finance ministry officials demonstrated on Wednesday to protest against job cuts and a spending freeze by the government.

The rally in front of the finance ministry followed two fruitless strikes last month over a reduction in staff numbers and salaries aimed at ensuring Austria qualifies for the European Union's planned single currency.
One protest banner read: "Edlinger -- finance's undertaker" in reference to Finance Minister Rudolf Edlinger.
Austrian civil servants are protected from redundancy by law and are relatively well-off in comparison with other public sectors in Europe.
But many Austrian public employees got no pay increase this year as part of the government's austerity programme.
